svg.title: PRS26001 PRS SE Custom 24 Burled Ash wiring reference
svg.desc: Wiring reference for Seymour Duncan APH-1b and APH-1n humbuckers, a four-pole five-way super switch with 1.8 kΩ partial-split resistors, a push-pull tone bypass, master volume with a 180 pF treble bleed, five operating states with measured resistance, and common ground.

g.text: PRS26001 PRS SE Custom 24 Burled Ash • WIRING REFERENCE
MATCH IDENTICAL BOXED NET LABELS • SWITCH CONTACTS SHOWN BY FUNCTION
Seymour Duncan Alnico II Pro • screw coils toward the bridge
Common closes to one numbered throw per position
A and B select the pickup hots. C and D join a pickup’s series link to its split resistor; when open, the pickup stays a full humbucker.
The push-pull changes no pickup connection.
Pulled up, the tone knob has no effect; pushing it
down restores the tone at the knob’s last setting.
TREBLE BLEED • across BUS and OUT
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down • clockwise = louder
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down • clockwise = brighter
Measured at the jack, volume full up • same with tone up or down
B_SP → 1.8 kΩ → GND (bridge partial split, positions 2 and 3)
N_SP → 1.8 kΩ → GND (neck partial split, positions 3 and 4)
GND = both green and bare leads • both split resistors • push-pull P down throw • volume CCW lug.
Bond pot cases, switch frame, copper cavity shielding, bridge/string ground, and jack sleeve to GND.
